scope: Non-blinded assistant review of saved development outputs; not independent human evaluation or a benchmark rescore.
review_method: Two assistant reviewers split the 32 supplied-evidence cases into disjoint batches of 16; each case has one reviewer. Root checked provenance, exact evidence excerpts and interpretation limits. No inter-rater agreement was measured.

rubric.packed_sufficiency: Whether generator-visible passages supply the requested facts; sufficient, partial, insufficient, or ambiguous scope.
rubric.answer_quality: Responsiveness, completeness and correctness within supplied evidence; adequate, partial, inadequate, ambiguous, or not_applicable for refusals.
rubric.selected_quote_support: Whether selected quotations support the entire emitted answer with the correct referents, independent of whether it answers the question.
rubric.clipping_effect: Material means an omitted original-paragraph continuation contains useful requested details; it does not prove that restoring them would change the output.

limitations: References and benchmark answerability were visible to reviewers; judgments are subjective and not blinded.
Original full paragraphs were available only for clipping diagnosis; the generator did not see omitted tails.
This is not a new full-paper audit and does not establish exhaustive paper-level answerability.
The 18 pre-generation threshold refusals are covered by the mechanical audit only; the 2 model refusals receive qualitative review.

Known NCEL caveat: case 114934e1a1e818630ff33ac5c4cd4be6c6f75bb2 is adequate relative to the supplied conclusion wording, but the prior paper-grounded review found the blanket outperformance claim overstated against table losses/ties. Its packed-only rating does not override that finding.
Label/reference conflicts are documented without changing frozen predictions, labels, metrics, gates or human-review templates.
